name: Tucana Dwarf
tagline: The Local Group's most isolated spheroidal — 2.9 Mly out, never influenced by a major galaxy.
history: Tucana is the Local Group's most isolated dwarf spheroidal — sitting near the group's edge, it has probably never passed close enough to the Milky Way or Andromeda to be stripped or stirred. Its entirely old stellar population reads as a fossil of the earliest epoch of galaxy formation. As a benchmark for 'pristine' dwarf evolution it anchors the environmental comparisons used to classify the rest of the Local Group.
